questions.stem: How can this application be deployed in the cloud using IaaS infrastructure?
questions.zhStem: 这个应用如何使用 IaaS 基础设施部署到云中？
options: Put all three tiers on one large VM to keep management simple
Give each tier its own subnet with two VMs in different availability zones
Run the web and API tiers on VMs and the database on App Service
Place each tier in a different Azure region with one VM per region
questions.explain: Each tier gets its own subnet and two VMs in different availability zones, because the N-tier reference architecture isolates tiers and survives the loss of one zone.
questions.zhExplain: 每一层都有自己的子网和分布在不同可用区的两台虚拟机，因为 N 层参考架构既隔离各层，又能在一个可用区故障时继续运行。

questions.stem: On IaaS, what does Azure supply and what must the customer manage?
questions.zhStem: 在 IaaS 中，Azure 提供什么，客户必须自己管理什么？
options: Azure patches the guest OS; the team manages only the application code
Azure manages the OS and runtime; the team manages only the data
Azure runs the database software; the team manages the VMs and network
Azure supplies the VMs, disks and network; the team manages all software on them
questions.explain: Azure supplies only the VMs, disks and network, because on IaaS the customer builds and maintains every piece of software, including the OS, on those VMs.
questions.zhExplain: Azure 只提供虚拟机、磁盘和网络，因为在 IaaS 中客户要自己构建和维护虚拟机上的所有软件，包括操作系统。

questions.stem: On IaaS, how do you keep web VMs off the internet and let only the web tier call the API tier?
questions.zhStem: 在 IaaS 中，如何让 Web VM 不直接暴露在互联网上，并且只允许 Web 层调用 API 层？
options: One subnet per tier; each NSG allows only traffic from the tier in front
One shared subnet for all tiers; one NSG allows all traffic inside the VNet
Give every VM a public IP and block unwanted ports in each VM's firewall
Put the API VMs behind the public load balancer next to the web VMs
questions.explain: Each tier sits in its own subnet whose NSG admits only the tier in front of it, because then the public load balancer is the only entry point and the API is reached only through the internal load balancer.
questions.zhExplain: 每一层都位于自己的子网中，其 NSG 只允许前一层的流量进入，因为这样公共负载均衡器就是唯一入口，而 API 只能通过内部负载均衡器访问。

questions.stem: How should an IaaS design use availability zones so one datacenter failure does not take the app offline?
questions.zhStem: IaaS 设计应如何使用可用性区域，使一个数据中心故障不会让应用下线？
options: Put both VMs of each tier in the same zone for lower latency
Use zones only for the database and keep the web tier in one zone
Place the two VMs of every tier in different availability zones
Replace availability zones with daily backups to another region
questions.explain: The two VMs of every tier go in different availability zones, because a failure in one zone then leaves a working VM in each tier.
questions.zhExplain: 每一层的两台虚拟机放在不同的可用区，因为这样一个可用区故障时，每一层仍有一台虚拟机在运行。

questions.stem: How can this application be deployed in the cloud using PaaS infrastructure?
questions.zhStem: 这个应用如何使用 PaaS 基础设施部署到云中？
options: Keep the VMs but turn on automatic OS updates for each of them
Move each VM into a container and run the containers on more VMs
Expose the Flask API with a public IP so the browser calls it directly
Replace each tier with a managed Azure service behind one public entry point
questions.explain: Each tier is replaced by a managed Azure service behind one public entry point, because Azure then runs the servers, patching, scaling and backups and the API is never called directly.
questions.zhExplain: 每一层都换成一个托管的 Azure 服务，并只保留一个公共入口，因为这样服务器、补丁、扩缩和备份都由 Azure 负责，而且 API 不会被直接调用。

questions.stem: Which service should host a Flask API that needs at least two instances across zones and automatic scale-out?
questions.zhStem: 哪个服务应托管需要跨区域至少两个实例并自动横向扩展的 Flask API？
options: Azure Static Web Apps, which serves the React build from a CDN
Azure App Service (Premium v3) with its built-in load balancer and autoscale
Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server with zone-redundant HA
Azure Key Vault with a managed identity for the connection string
questions.explain: App Service (Premium v3) hosts the Flask API, because it runs multiple zone-spread instances behind a built-in load balancer and autoscale adds instances.
questions.zhExplain: Flask API 由 App Service（Premium v3）托管，因为它能在内置负载均衡器后面运行分布在多个可用区的实例，并通过自动缩放增加实例。

questions.stem: For a web app, when is PaaS a better choice than self-managed VMs on IaaS?
questions.zhStem: 对于 Web 应用，什么时候 PaaS 比 IaaS 上自管理的虚拟机更合适？
options: When every tier can run as a managed service and the team wants to focus on code
When the team needs full control of the OS and every server setting
When the team wants to patch, scale and back up each server itself
When the app depends on custom OS drivers that managed services do not allow
questions.explain: PaaS is the better fit when every tier runs as a managed service, because Azure then handles patching, scaling, monitoring and backups and the team can focus on the code.
questions.zhExplain: 当每一层都能以托管服务运行时，PaaS 更合适，因为补丁、扩缩、监控和备份都由 Azure 处理，团队可以专注于代码。

questions.stem: For each case, how do you draw a diagram that represents the target architecture and describe each of the chosen cloud components?
questions.zhStem: 对于每种情况，如何画出表示目标架构的图，并描述所选的每个云组件？
options: Draw one diagram for both cases and list only the tier names
Draw only the current app diagram and skip the cloud services
Draw each case's Azure components and links, then state each one's role
Skip the diagrams and compare the monthly price of each case
questions.explain: Draw one diagram per case with every chosen component and its connections, then give each component's role, because the rubric gives 1 mark for the diagram and 2 marks for the description.
questions.zhExplain: 每种情况画一张图，标出所选的每个组件及其连线，再写出每个组件的作用，因为评分标准给图 1 分、给描述 2 分。
